Digital Inclusion & Data Privacy Standards

Modern privacy frameworks like GDPR and CCPA require explicit consent before tracking scripts execute. Simultaneously, the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA Title III) and European Accessibility Act (EAA) require digital properties to achieve Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.2 AA) compliance.

With CookieAccess, website visitors can fine-tune their reading experience using dyslexia-friendly typography, custom letter spacing, high contrast palettes, laser reading guides, and audio speech narration.
